messages.subject: Re: Save additional estimates in output (from a mediation model)
messages.subject_clean: Save additional estimates in output (from a mediation model)
messages.body_plain:
Dear MplusAutomation users,

I wanted to give you the update that I've written an initial parser for MODEL INDIRECT output and added it to the development version of the package: https://github.com/michaelhallquist/MplusAutomation. If you have MODEL INDIRECT output, it will be returned in $indirect by readModels(). I haven't tested this extensively, but it works for a file I have that has extensive output of this sort. There are a number of ways I could have formatted the Mplus output into R objects, so please let me know if you have problems with this new parser or suggestions for another way to parse it. At the moment, two data.frames $overall and $specific are the subelements of $indirect, the first containing total, total indirect, and direct effects; the second containing all specific paths with the mediating variables pasted together in the $intervening column.

Hope this helps in your work. This will be part of the forthcoming 0.7 version of the package on CRAN -- that will support Mplus v8, too. Stay tuned...

Best,
Michael

messages.subject: Re: [MplusAutomation] Re: subscript out of bounds
messages.body_plain:
Hi KyungSook,

Thanks for sending this output. I had a chance to review it and the bug resulted from Mplus v8 removing the leading '1' from parameter vectors in the TECH1 output. I've now programmed a workaround to support both formats (v7 and v8) and your output now reads in successfully. You'll need to install the development version of MplusAutomation: https://github.com/michaelhallquist/MplusAutomation.

Best,
Michael

Hi Fernando and CJ,

Thanks for sending the full output file, Fernando. I was able to verify that the problem you encountered is now fixed in the development version (https://github.com/michaelhallquist/MplusAutomation), which will soon be released to CRAN as v0.7. CJ, your issue was a bit more peculiar, reflecting the empty section header for I1, but no subsequent parameter. I haven't seen this output before (or since), so it must be a rare occasion. I emulated this by adding the line from your output into an existing file and encountered the same bug. I've now incorporated a workaround into the package that skips over blank sections, which is also fixed in the development version of the package.

Best,
Michael

messages.subject: Bug hunt and beta testing MplusAutomation support for version 8
messages.subject_clean: Bug hunt and beta testing MplusAutomation support for version 8
messages.body_plain:
Dear MplusAutomation community,

Josh and I have been hard at work updating MplusAutomation with the hope of releasing version 0.7 to CRAN in the next few weeks. This version supports outputs from Mplus version 8 and fixes a number of small bugs that have affected parsing of certain outputs. The updated package also handles parsing errors more gracefully, extracting what it can, rather than crashing out. We have also tried to implement some of the more frequently requested features. In particular, the readModels function now parses the MODEL INDIRECT section, storing it in $indirect in the returned object. For all of the exciting updates, see: https://github.com/michaelhallquist/MplusAutomation/blob/master/NEWS.

In addition to this informational update, I am writing to ask for your help and input on two items.

1) If you have time, please test the development version of the package, especially with v8 outputs. (Directions to install dev version are here: https://github.com/michaelhallquist/MplusAutomation).
2) If you encounter problems with the development version, or if there's a lingering bug that has fallen through the cracks, please report it here: https://github.com/michaelhallquist/MplusAutomation/issues. On the Github issue post, please describe the problem and upload the files necessary to reproduce it (typically the .out uploaded as a .txt file). Please also include the output of sessionInfo() from R. We are using Github to track issues in the package and would like to centralize bug reports there.

Finally, please note that the package only has basic support for EFA model outputs, and this is unlikely to change in the near future. Model summaries and fit statistics should be extracted reasonably well, but parameters will not be.

Thanks, and best wishes,
Michael
